costs.note: cost_estimate blocks in *.meta.json are undiscounted list price; Gemini real-time flex carries the same 50 % discount as the async Batch API, so the flex column is the billed basis.

passes_versus_overlap.question: Do extra passes substitute for extra overlap? Earlier, scope-confounded work suggested 384 px / 12.5 % at K = 10 reached a higher union-recall ceiling than 512 px / 50 % at K = 3 for less money. On one footprint this grid can settle it.
passes_versus_overlap.verdict: passes do NOT substitute for overlap
